summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting an open-market share buyback. On 2 July 2026, it repurchased 5,000,000 ordinary shares at prices between 112.20p and 114.95p (volume-weighted average 113.8668p) via Goldman Sachs International. These purchases are part of a pre-existing buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026. The shares will be cancelled. Routine buyback disclosures are not a special situation.
